page.layout: One title page: large title block at top centre; a woodcut engraving of an anchor with a serpent in the centre, with two vertical mottoes beside it (left and right); publisher and date block below the engraving. No margin notes.

main_text.l: in omnes Pauli Apostoli Epistolas, atque etiam in Epistolam ad Hebraeos.

l.i: Eiusdem Authoris Commentarios in omnes Epistolas Canonicas.

main_text.l: Commentariorum postremam esse recognitionem, ex lectione atque collatione cum prioribus, deprehendet Lector.
Anchora sacra mari iactatos unica Christus
Fundat, & est omni tempore sola salus.

page.notes: The side mottoes are vertical: left "Anchora sacra mari iactatos unica Christus" (with a pilcrow before it), right "Fundat, & est omni tempore sola salus". The engraving shows an anchor entwined by a serpent, with hands gripping the shank and sea creatures below. Some lines are damaged by stains and tears on the left edge; "Eustathii Vignon" is read from the scan as printed with a stroke over a letter, and "Vicnon" is transcribed as shown.
